Appellants have filed this first criminal appeal under Section 14A(2) of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 on behalf of the appellant for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.500/2023 registered at P.S. Kannod, District Dewas (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 376(D), 343 and 506 of IPC and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii) and 3(2)(v) of SC/ ST Act.

sentences.text: They are in custody since 21.11.2023.
2. As per prosecution story, on 07.02.2023, at about 08:00 AM, in the morning, the prosecutrix had gone for cutting the crops in the agriculture land o f co-accused Ravi Jaat.

On the same day, at about 06:00 PM, co-accused Ravi Jaat told her that there is some work regarding cleaning in his house and on his saying, she went to his house and did cleaning work and when she was returning to her house, at that time, co-accused Ravi Jaat told her that she will not go to her house and forcibly took her in the room and committed rape upon her.

Then he locked her in his house for a period of three days and on 10.02.2023, at about 11-11:30 PM, co-accused Ravi and his maternal uncle Nand Ram Jaat took her on motor-cycle in the house of other co-accused Devilal, then Ravi Jaat and Devilal committed gang rape upon her and present applicant and other co-accused persons were also present outside the room.

On the next date, when her husband reached there, he released her from the custody of accused persons, then she went in Nari Niketan, Ujjain and after about one month her sister-in-law/ Suman came in the Nari Niketan, then she went along with her at Village Khiroda,
Satwas.
After that, she lodged an FIR against the accused persons.
Accordingly, offence has been registered.
3 . Learned counsel for the appellants submit that the appellants are innocent persons and they have been falsely implicated in this offence.
They are in custody since 21.11.2023.
they are not the main accused, who have committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
Limited allegation has been levelled against the accused persons.

Incident was taken place on 10.02.2023 and on the same day the husband has lodged an FIR bearing Crime No.71/2023 at P.S. Kannod, District Dewas against the husband, father in law, brother in law and other family members of the prosecutrix.

Accordingly,
offence 147, 148, 149, 294, 436 and 506 of IPC has been registered against her husband and other family members.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
Co- accused Suresh has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 10.01.2024 passed in CRA No.274/2024 in the similar circumstances.
They are the permanent resident of District Dewas.

Under the above circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.
4 . Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the criminal appeal and prays for its rejection.
5. Counsel for the complainant also opposes the prayer and prays for its rejection.
6. Perused the impugned order of the trial Court and the case diary.

7 . Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that applicant has filed certified copy of the FIR, which was lodged against the husband and other family members of the prosecutrix on the same day of incident, which is created doubt upon the prosecutrix's presence on the place of occurrence;
applicants are not the main accused, who have committed rape upon the prosecutrix; limited allegation has been levelled against the applicants; the case of the applicants is identical with the co- accused, who has been enlarged on bail and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
In view of the limited role attributed to the appellants, I deem it proper to release the appellant on bail.
7 . Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand only) each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
